author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Adapt-MinQuota: Min-2-per-batch + Global Fill (k=48)
abstract: Dual BRBG with adaptive per-PC residualization on graph PCs and a min-quota balanced kNN: ensure at least 2 neighbors per batch, then fill remaining to k=48 by global nearest neighbors (cosine, binary). Goal: preserve local structure while guaranteeing cross-batch edges.
